_comment: Created 2026-08-18 alongside the International Delight config, same period. brand.color and brand.light_bg were sampled 2026-08-20 from a screenshot of silk.com's homepage (navy background/wordmark + cream card). brand.accent_color has no second real color to sample from that crop — set to the same navy as a monochrome placeholder; replace with a real secondary/CTA color if one turns up (e.g. from a button, not just the hero). Quality Report sheet remains TBD. ga4_ads_file_id set 2026-09-23 — a GA4 'Compare' Explore export (both Q2 2026 and Q1 2026 in one file, verified against its Grand total row: Key events sum to an exact match for both periods). pipeline/sem_qv.py auto-detects this shape and reads both periods from it, so ga4_ads_file_id_p2 is left TBD — it's an alternate path for a brand that instead provides two separate flat exports, not needed here.
_quality_score_comment: qs_sheet_id set 2026-09-24 — same shape as International Delight's export (real spreadsheet 'quality_score_silk_q1_v_q2', separate Q1/Q2 tabs, headers on row 3: 'Search term'/'Search terms match type'/'Added/Excluded'/'Keyword final URL'/'Quality Score'/'Landing page exp.'/'Ad relevance'). Found by checking the registry's Quality Report row column E (not just C/D) after the same miss happened for ID. Pointed at the 'Q2' tab (current period). scripts/build_html.py's header-based load_qs_data() rewrite handles this shape correctly — verified against ID's real data before wiring this one up.
_competitors_comment: Added 2026-08-20. Curated from the registry's 'COMPETITORS' candidate row (see 16-h0rmI.../SILK row 16, sourced from Carla Klaasen's Keyword Study filter formula — the same source described in the 'Topical cluster' reference, see onesearch_mechanics.html). That raw row is a pipe-delimited blob mixing real competitors with retailers, generic terms, and unrelated brands: kroger, walmart, amazon, aveeno, trader joe, kirkland, whole foods, private label, maker, vitamix, can, powder, thai, fage, coco lopez were deliberately excluded as non-competitors, per explicit instruction not to copy-paste it wholesale. 'diamond' → Blue Diamond (Almond Breeze's parent) rather than a bare pattern, to avoid matching unrelated 'diamond' keywords. Still needs a second human pass — this list is not guaranteed complete or fully correct.
_taxonomy_prompt_comment: Added 2026-09-24. This brand's KS TOPIC column is 100% blank (0 of 16,141 rows classified) — unlike International Delight, where the KS sheet turned out to already be complete. Started with scripts/classify_ks_taxonomy.py directly against the KS sheet (durable long-term, since match_ks.py re-reads KS fresh every pipeline run), but stopped a partial run (only ~2,400 of 16,041 classified, none of which got written — the script defers all writes to the end of the run) in favor of enabling `enrich_taxonomy` below, matching the approach used for ID. That means this brand's Masterlist-level TOPICS gets (re-)classified by Claude on every real pipeline run rather than the KS sheet being fixed once — a real ongoing per-run API cost given KS starts from zero, worth revisiting later if that adds up; classify_ks_taxonomy.py is still there and usable for a proper one-time KS-level fix whenever that's preferred over the recurring cost. Topics chosen by explicit user decision: mirrors Oikos's real curated territories list (BRAND, PRODUCT, COMPETITOR, GENERIC, HEALTH, SOURCE OF PROTEIN, RECIPE, CONSUMER HABITS, OTHER), dropping SOURCE OF PROTEIN as yogurt-specific. Keeps a distinct BRAND vs PRODUCT split so SEM Recommendation tagging can actually fire for this brand.

taxonomy_prompt.brand_context: Silk, a plant-based dairy-alternative beverage brand (almond, oat, soy, and coconut milks, creamers, and yogurts)

_sem_qv_comment: competitor_blocklist added 2026-09-24, reused from this file's own curated competitors[].patterns (not the raw registry COMPETITORS blob, which still has uncurated noise like 'kroger'/'walmart'/'can'/'powder' deliberately excluded from competitors[] below) — sem_qv.py's tag_sem_recommendations() checks this via exact normalized-keyword membership, not substring matching. Currently a no-op in practice since TOPICS never equals 'BRAND' for this brand yet (KS taxonomy is 100% blank — see project memory) — wired up now so it's active as soon as that's fixed.
